## Plugin reference

- Description: Arc progress: one unbroken arc on a faint ring, filled clockwise from the top through the current step (step 1 of 4 is a quarter, the last step the whole circle); one colour, no segments. Hover or click lists every step.
- Web:
  - Contributes: `SegmentedProgressBarSlots.Variant` "Arc" → `ArcRenderer`
  - Uses:
    - `primitives/css/rigid.rigidClass`
    - `primitives/css/ui-kit.cn`
    - `ui/segmented-progress-bar.progressStepLabel`
    - `ui/segmented-progress-bar.ProgressStepsTooltip`
    - `ui/segmented-progress-bar.SegmentedProgressBarSlots`
